Yasser Hassan Abul, Chairman of ABYAT (centre), and HE Sheikh Faisal bin Thani bin Faisal Al Thani, Minister of Commerce and Industry (right) at the ABYAT pavilion. Image Courtesy: ABYAT

Gulf home giant debuts its Home of Homes as Official Home Partner of Build Your House Qatar 2026

Press Release

  • Curated pavilion journey invites visitors to explore ABYAT’s categories and discover ideas for their dream home
  • Chairman Yasser Hassan Abul attends the opening ceremony alongside Minister of Commerce and Industry and dignitaries
  • ABYAT’s store at Mall of Qatar opens soon

Doha, QATAR – ABYAT, the regional home finishing and furnishing group, makes its debut in Qatar this week as Official Home Partner of Build Your House Qatar 2026, taking place from 26-28 October at the Qatar National Convention Centre. 

The exhibition marks a further step towards ABYAT’s flagship store at Mall of Qatar, which opens soon. 

ABYAT’s Home of Homes pavilion has been curated like a museum. Visitors move from one gallery to the next, exploring doors and windows, tiles, kitchens, bathrooms, lighting and finishing touches, alongside ideas for furnishing and accessorising their dream home.

Families can also join Aamer, ABYAT’s reward programme, at the pavilion and learn about exclusive offers during the exhibition.

As an innovator, manufacturer and retailer, ABYAT designs its products for homes that balance everyday practicality with personal style and local customs. Its retail business serves individual homeowners, while its dedicated projects division works with contractors and developers on product selection, specifications, supply and installation. Across both, the company combines design expertise with a broad product portfolio to accommodate different spaces and budgets.

Quote – Yasser Hassan Abul, Chairman of ABYAT: “The Qatari market holds significant promise. Our expansion into Qatar represents another important milestone in ABYAT’s strategy to continue growing across the GCC markets, building on our experience in Kuwait and Saudi Arabia. Our ambition is for ABYAT to become the first choice for families in Qatar when finishing and furnishing their homes.”

Quote – Mohammed Khaled Abul, CEO of ABYAT: “Qatar marks an exciting new chapter in ABYAT’s journey, bringing our vision of redefining the home experience to one of the Gulf’s most dynamic markets. For over 20 years, we have combined manufacturing expertise, product innovation and a deep understanding of how Gulf families live to create a destination where every part of the home comes together. Our participation in Build Your House is an opportunity to introduce Qatari homeowners to the ABYAT experience ahead of our flagship opening, bringing together inspiring design, exceptional quality and lasting value under one roof. We look forward to making ABYAT Qatar’s Home of Homes.”

ABYAT’s entry into Qatar forms part of the group’s regional expansion, alongside two new branches in Saudi Arabia and plans to enter the United Arab Emirates. The company’s investment in Qatar will create new jobs and support the objectives of Qatar National Vision 2030.

ABYAT has served more than a million families to date. Today, the group employs more than 3,000 people, operates a fleet of over 350 delivery and installation vehicles, and carries more than 30,000 products across its showrooms and online store.

The exhibition is open daily from 10am to 10pm, and registration is free at https://platform.smarteventsmanager.com/register/byh26?source=3BZ2.

About ABYAT:

ABYAT is a Gulf home group that brings together everything a home needs, from its aluminium windows and doors to its final furnishings, and manages each step between the factory and the family’s front door. Founded in Kuwait in 2005, the group manufactures aluminium doors and windows, glass systems, kitchens, internal doors, wardrobes, countertops and selected furniture at ABYAT Industrial City in Saudi Arabia, and runs its own warehousing, delivery, installation and after-sales service. ABYAT serves homeowners, contractors and developers through its showrooms in Kuwait and Saudi Arabia, its online store and a dedicated projects business, and is expanding into Qatar, followed by the United Arab Emirates. The group has served more than one million families, employs more than 3,000 people and operates a fleet of over 350 delivery and installation vehicles.
